title: Outcome Flywheel Record
description: One append-only record per shipped SOW outcome. Captures the prediction made at handoff and (later) the realized outcome, so NSOS measures predicted-vs-realized and feeds the eval set — the moat. Append-only: a prediction row is written at ship; a realization row is written when the outcome lands; both share run_id+sow_id.

record_type.description: prediction = written at SOW ship (from the handoff packet); realization = written when the outcome is observed

predicted.description: Present on record_type=prediction. The quantified target from the FDE handoff packet.

realized.description: Present on record_type=realization. The observed outcome after the engagement ships.

source.description: Source trace for every number (grounded-numbers contract carried to the flywheel).
